card.text: Kepler-90 i was found in 2017 by Kepler as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-90i"
sources.quote: Kepler-90i (also known by its Kepler Object of Interest designation KOI-351.08) is a super-Earth exoplanet with a radius 1.32 times that of Earth, orbiting the early G-type main sequence star Kepler-90 every 14.45 days, discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft.

introduction.text: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Shallue & Vanderburg 2018's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-90i"
sources.quote: It is located about 2,840 light-years (870 parsecs, or nearly 2.4078×1016 km) from Earth in the constellation Draco.

shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
